title: 第九十二章  鸡肋
slug: 替弟入赘后我被女帝赖上了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

大殿内依旧一片死寂。

所有人都心知肚明，军队现在就是个空壳子。

但谁敢在这个时候，主动说出“割让河朔平原”这样的话？

这可是要背负万世骂名的卖国贼罪名。

谁说，谁就是主动给女帝递了一把悬在头顶的刀子，以后御史台的唾沫星子能把人淹死。

严复低着头，退回了队列中，顾延年也悄悄往后缩了缩，同样保持着沉默。

就在这令人窒息的沉默中，上官绡的目光，突然落在了一个角落里。

那里站着一个年轻的官员，正百无聊赖地抠着自己的指甲。

正是户部员外郎兼殿中侍御史——赵知武。

上官绡心中微微一动，忽然开口。

“赵知武赵爱卿。”

被突然点名，赵知武浑身一震，连忙收回手，大步走了出来。

“微臣在！”

赵知武脸上不仅没有丝毫慌乱，反而隐隐带着一丝兴奋。

他等这一刻，已经等了整整一个晚上了。

脑子里那些顾淮昨天晚上教他的词，他早就背得滚瓜烂熟。

“赵知武，你是这次接待使团的副使之一。”

上官绡看着他，缓缓问道。

“对于党项索要河朔平原一事，你有什么想法？”

赵知武挺起胸膛，深吸了一口气。

“启奏陛下，微臣认为，这河朔平原，咱们不仅要给，而且要给得痛痛快快！”

赵知武的声音极其响亮，在大殿内嗡嗡作响。

此言一出，犹如在平静的湖面中投下了一颗巨石。

整个大明殿瞬间炸开了锅。

“放肆！”

严复猛地转过身，指着赵知武的鼻子怒喝。

“竖子安敢在此大放厥词！”

“割地求和，乃是丧权辱国之举，你赵家好歹也是国公之后，怎会出你这等懦弱无能之辈！”

右骁卫郎将严腾也跨出一步，眼中满是杀意。

“赵知武，你这是卖国！”

“我西北将士在前方流血牺牲，你却在朝堂上轻飘飘一句‘给得痛快’，你对得起那些死去的兄弟吗？”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

There was still deathly silence in the hall.

Everyone knows that the army is now an empty shell.

But who dares to take the initiative to say "cede the Heshuo Plain" at this time?

This is a traitor charge that will lead to eternal infamy.

Whoever said it took the initiative to hand the empress a knife hanging above her head. From now on, the spittle of Yushitai can drown people.

Yan Fu lowered his head and retreated into the queue. Gu Yannian also quietly shrank back, remaining silent as well.

In this suffocating silence, Shangguan Xiao's eyes suddenly fell on a corner.

There stood a young official, picking his nails out of boredom.

It was Zhao Zhiwu, a member of the household department and a censor in the palace.

Shangguan Xiao's heart moved slightly and he suddenly spoke.

"Zhao Zhiwu and Zhao Aiqing."

Zhao Zhiwu was shocked when his name was suddenly called, he quickly retracted his hand and strode out.

"Wei Chen is here!"

Not only was there no trace of panic on Zhao Zhiwu's face, but there was a hint of excitement on his face.

He had been waiting for this moment all night.

He had already memorized the words that Gu Huai taught him last night in his mind.

"Zhao Zhiwu, you are one of the deputy envoys receiving the mission this time."

Shangguan Xiao looked at him and asked slowly.

"What do you think about Dang Xiang's request for Heshuo Plain?"

Zhao Zhiwu puffed up his chest and took a deep breath.

"Your Majesty, I believe that we must not only give to the Heshuo Plain, but we must give it to you heartily!"

Zhao Zhiwu's voice was extremely loud, buzzing in the hall.

As soon as these words were spoken, it was like dropping a huge boulder into the calm lake.

The entire Daming Palace exploded instantly.

"Presumptuous!"

Yan Fu turned around suddenly, pointed at Zhao Zhiwu's nose and shouted angrily.

"How dare Shu Zian speak nonsense here!"

"To cede territory and seek peace is an act of losing power and humiliating the country. You, the Zhao family, are also the princes of the country after all. How could there be such a cowardly and incompetent person like you!"

Youxiao Weilang General Yan Teng also took a step forward, his eyes full of killing intent.

"Zhao Zhiwu, you are traitorous!"

"My soldiers from the northwest bled and died on the front line, but you just said, 'It's a pleasure' in the court hall. Are you worthy of those dead brothers?"
